description: This line plot illustrates how Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio change as a function of the Recent Sequence Ratio (%), with two separate y-axes representing these metrics. The x-axis, labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)”, ranges from 0 to 100 and is presented on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 20. The left y-axis, labeled “Perplexity”, ranges from 4.2 to 4.7 and is also on a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The right y-axis, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)”, ranges from 40 to 100 and is on a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot displays four lines: the orange line with circle markers represents “Perplexity”, starting at approximately 4.6 and ending at approximately 4.4; the blue line with circle markers represents “GPU Mem. Ratio”, starting at approximately 42 and ending at approximately 98; the red dashed line represents “Full Cache PPL”, which remains constant at approximately 4.4; and the blue dashed line represents “Full Cache GPU Mem.”, which remains constant at approximately 98.
